annotation.title_clean: Bozza di linee guida per l'adozione di Intelligenza Artificiale nella pubblica amministrazione
annotation.title_en: Draft Guidelines for the Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in the Public Administration
annotation.authors_or_issuer: AgID - Agenzia per l'Italia Digitale (with ACN, ANAC, ANCI, Dipartimento Funzione Pubblica, Dipartimento Trasformazione Digitale, INAIL, INPS, ISTAT, IPZS, MEF, MIMIT)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: AgID's draft guidelines (v1.0, Feb 2025, public consultation) for Italian public administrations adopting AI. They align with the EU AI Act risk tiers and set PDCA-based adoption model, ethics codes, transparency, data governance, data protection and cybersecurity requirements, with annexes on risk, impact, maturity and KPIs. No physical robotics content.
key_provisions_or_claims: PAs must classify AI systems by AI Act risk level and identify their role as provider or deployer
PAs must adopt an AI strategy coordinated by the Digital Transition Officer (RTD)
High-risk deployers must conduct FRIA and DPIA and ensure human oversight
PAs must adopt a binding ethical code for AI
Mandatory risk management, KPIs, documentation, logging and staff training
